method_card.objective: Search successive pages of bibliographic evidence in Europe PMC and Crossref, including publications beyond the first page.
method_card.mechanism: Use a gx.scholarly-request/1 JSON and parameters query and action=first. Inspect sources[].has_more and coverage. With the same query, supply the named search-snapshot.json from the previous Job and action=next to advance one page. Use action=replay to decode an archived page offline. Use candidates.json with the page-fetch method for open JATS.
method_card.estimator: For each provider and merged query, distinguish page rows, newly seen and cumulative publication IDs, upstream total if available, open-access flags, archived abstract metadata and actual acquisition/reading.
method_card.training_data_lineage: Public catalogue and original-source records; no trained model.

manifest.licence: GX release source. Original materials retain their respective licences.
manifest.licence_basis: Europe PMC and Crossref public metadata and Open Access JATS terms; intake records retain original source rights.
manifest.limitations: One bounded page per provider per Job. Coverage is per query and provider; unknown/missing continuation or a network failure cannot support a global scientific negative. Matching publications can share experiments and samples.
